rationale: Both nodes define the union of two sets using the same notation (S ∪ T and A ∪ B) and the same semantic description: a set containing elements from either set. The difference in variable names (S/T vs. A/B) and phrasing ('gồm các phần tử' vs 'gồm tất cả các phần tử') is purely wording. They represent the same reusable mathematical concept.
